title: concordance.validate output
description: Result of validating an Object Catalog manifest against the vendored Concordance wire contract.

valid.description: True iff the manifest passes AJV validation against the vendored manifest.schema.json (after schema_version strip).

errors.description: AJV-native error shape, preserved for Pydantic detail.errors[] parity per the F2 / hosted Concordance convention.

warnings.description: Non-fatal version-policy notes (e.g. patch or minor schema_version drift).

schemaVersion.description: schema_version observed on the manifest. Null when the manifest omits the field.

versionPolicy.description: Outcome of the version policy check against the Forge schema_version pin.

expectedSchemaVersion.description: Forge's pinned Concordance schema_version (see version-policy.ts FORGE_SCHEMA_VERSION_PIN).

source.description: Whether the validated manifest was provided inline or loaded from disk.

manifestPath.description: Resolved manifest path when source=file. Always relative to projectRoot.

entityCount.description: Number of entities in the validated manifest (best-effort; 0 when the payload is malformed).

keyword.description: AJV keyword that failed (e.g., required, type, additionalProperties).

instancePath.description: JSON pointer to the offending location in the payload.

schemaPath.description: JSON pointer into the schema that produced this error.
